page.layout: One printed page of running text, with a column of small marginal notes in the left margin. Below the text: the heading AXIOMATA and a numbered list of six lines. The right side shows the edge of the facing page and show-through, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Quare qui offert æque[?] re movendus?vendos esse a tutela : {b}quia satisdatio tutoris propon[illegible, ~2 letters] malevolum non mutat, sed diutius grassandi in re mi-liari facultatem præstat. Estne tutor pauper suspectus?{c}Suspectum etiam eum putau[illegible, ~2 letters] qui moribus talis est, ut suspectus sit. Enimvero tut[illegible, ~2 letters] curator, quamvis pauper est, fidelis tamen & diligens movendus non est quasi suspectus.:

Nono in §. ult. h. n. reprobat cautionem quandam, qua suspe-ctus fortasse se tueri velit: & ostendit, quamvis satisdare vel[illegible, ~2 letters] pupilli, vel adolescentis salvam fore, nihilominus eum a tu[illegible, ~3 letters] vel cura removeri. ratio est: quia (ut supra diximus) non suspectus propter paupertatem, sed propter malos mores nde[illegible, ~2 letters] pauper non removetur a tutela quasi suspectus: dummodo [illegible, ~2 letters] delis: alioquin ob dolum remorveretur, & diligens alioqu[illegible, ~2 letters] moveretur ob culpam [v. not. sup. §. 6. de excus. tut.] satis[illegible, ~3 letters] vero facultatum, non morum defectum supplet. Adde, quo pu-pillo expedit rem salvam habere, potius quam actionem he[illegible, ~3 letters] ob rem a tutore perditam. ff. hoc tit. l. suspectus. §. [Pa[?] tamen qui se ingerunt suspecti habentur; homines scil. ex [illegible, ~3 letters] ta turba sumti, quos ipsa inopia refellit: & facile infideles possunt, ideoque removendi: juxta Antumu[?]. in l. 8. ff. h.] §

page.notes: Right-hand edge: show-through and the facing page's margin text, not transcribed. Faint ghosted text in the lower half of the page (and the faint "A NA" near the lower right) appears to be show-through, so it is not transcribed. Words cut off by the right-hand show-through are marked as illegible or with [?]; "propon[...]", "putau[...]", "tut[...]" and "diligens" are the uncertain ones. "suspe-" at the line break in the second paragraph is a best reading. "Antumu" and "Pa[?]" are doubtful. The left-margin note "æque" is read with a ligature and marked [?]. The final axiom line "ult," has a comma as printed.
